risks.description: Institutional capacity poses challenges to delivering the reform effort, despite very high leadership commitment and fast-paced GoA initiation of reforms.
risks.mitigation: The Project Preparation Facility (PPF) is designed to assist capacity building for the implementing agency; the TA part of the loan continues building capacity to deliver, addressing the most pressing capacity needs.

risks.description: Fiduciary risks related to the new form of financial instrument used in Albania.
risks.mitigation: The TA part of the loan helps mitigate the fiduciary risk by supporting fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU.

risks.description: Technical design risk, named alongside the fiduciary risk as being addressed by the same TA support (fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU); not separately elaborated beyond this.
risks.mitigation: The TA part of the loan helps mitigate the technical design risk by supporting fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU.

risks.description: Stakeholder risks arising from inter-agency coordination.
risks.mitigation: Mitigated by strong emphasis on coordination mechanisms in the design of the operation.

risks.description: Bureaucratic resistance to enhanced transparency and simplification of administrative processes.
risks.mitigation: Mitigated in part through high-level leadership and engagement, and through citizen feedback arrangements that help pinpoint poor performance and corruption.

risks.description: Political cycle risk from elections coming up in 2017, which could disrupt reform continuity and government commitment.
risks.mitigation: Mitigated by making early progress in showing results and ensuring a broad constituency of support for the project's objectives and activities among the leadership of participating institutions and service users.

notes: Text-driven extraction, NOT rating-driven: unlike the other 4 projects in this batch, Albania's narrative (paras 47-48) names 5 risks explicitly (low capacity, fiduciary, stakeholder/coordination, bureaucratic resistance to transparency, political cycle) plus a 6th (technical design) introduced only via its shared mitigation sentence with fiduciary. Two of these (R05, R06) map to Political and Governance, which the SORT table rates only Moderate - confirming that narration in this PAD is not reliably predicted by SORT severity tier, unlike the other 4 projects in this batch where narrated risks = exactly the Substantial/High rows. The 2 remaining SORT categories (Macroeconomic, Sector Strategies and Policies - both Moderate) and Environment and Social (Low) and Other (blank) are not discussed in the narrative.
